description: This file defines a custom annotation @Pagination for specifying pagination parameters in API methods within the Fineract project. It includes properties for value (number of items), size, and maximumSize, with default values and aliasing between value and size.

classes.name: Pagination
classes.description: Custom annotation for pagination parameters in API endpoints, allowing aliasing between 'value' and 'size' with default values and maximum size limit.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Alias for 'size' parameter; defaults to 50. Represents the number of items per page.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Alias for 'value' parameter; defaults to 50. Represents the number of items per page.

methods.name: maximumSize
methods.description: Maximum allowable value for pagination size; defaults to 10000.
